This avoids induction by treating the choice as a methodological rule for error elimination rather than a prediction of success.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
